name: textbee
description: Open-source Twilio alternative — turn an Android phone into an SMS gateway; send/receive programmatically with no per-message gateway fees. Free / Pro ~$9.99 / Scale ~$29.99.

mentions.evidence: ~$3.6k MRR, 327 active subscriptions, ~$3.7k L30, ~$31.4k all-time, ~30k users claimed, founded Nov 2024, Ethiopia, bootstrapped. Last sync Sep 30, 2026.
mentions.indieAngle: Open-core + cheap pro tier for a commodity API (SMS, email, WhatsApp) that businesses already budget for.
